headline: As of 2026-10-23: 22,765,597 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 46 of 50 states, D+12.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 22,765,597 early/mail ballots cast so far across 46 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+12.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (2,968,612), California (2,473,816), Florida (2,094,751).
